description.en-US:
Photograph what you are about to eat, as thoughtlessly as you would reach
into a bowl of peanuts. The widget, the quick-settings tile or the app's
big button open the viewfinder; a touch anywhere (or a volume key) takes
the photo and the screen closes by itself. Each photo is labelled
breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack from the time it was taken. The home
screen is one folder per day. Physical activity in one tap: strength
training, intense activity, endurance, or a line of your own. Your weight
once a day, with a curve of how it moves. Everything
stays on the phone: no network permission, no account. Export the journal
as one zip to carry it to a new phone; importing adds and replaces
nothing. Black and white, text only, six languages.
